public_open_space.description: This is a large plaza with planter boxes, along with smaller spaces along Davis Street. There is also space for food service to serve the plaza in the future.
public_open_space.seating: 16 movable chairs, 4 tables, 52' of bench seating

permit_summary.note: DBI holds 716 permits for this parcel, most of them tenant improvements on individual floors. The timeline shows the 24 largest by stated cost, plus the earliest on file; the DBI query in the sources below returns all 716. 18 of them are nominal $1 street-space or sidewalk permits.

sections.heading: Bethlehem Steel's Pacific Coast headquarters
sections.body: The structural columns stand outside the perimeter walls — a choice informed by the seismic research of the day, and one that put the client's product on show. The American Institute of Steel Construction gave the building an Architectural Award of Excellence in 1961.
